name: Sesame Crusted Tofu with Avocado & Green Bean-Bell Pepper Sauté
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim green beans, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Place eggs and cornstarch in another medium bowl; beat with a whisk or fork until smooth.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, place sesame seeds on another plate. Dip tofu in the egg mixture, then dredge in the sesame seeds, pressing gently to adhere; return to the baking sheet.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and pan-fry until the coating is golden and tofu is warmed through, 3-4 minutes per side. Return to the baking sheet and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl with the green beans.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; add both to the bowl.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocados; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide tofu and veggies between plates or bowls; top tofu with avocado. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
